**Scheduled Exports — Customer FAQ**

**What is scheduled exports?**
Scheduled exports let you automatically export your data on a recurring schedule.

**When will it be available?**
The feature launches on November 4.

**Which file formats are supported?**
You can choose CSV or JSON.

**Is there a limit on how much data I can export at once?**
Yes. Each scheduled export is limited to 10,000 rows.

**Is this real-time data synchronization?**
No. Scheduled exports are periodic snapshots, not real-time synchronization.
